title: Learning Math
author: dwaters
excerpt: I am in my early thirties and honestly, I cant claim to have a good background in math. But, I now have a burning desire to learn it from the ground-up. What are the 'canonical' sources for math, both online and offline? I am lost as to where I should start. I want to have a fundamental, intuitive understanding of it. To clarify, I would not consider it shameful to start at whatever level necessary (even the lowest, if required).
